description: LyfeOS 13-layer production stack design — desired end state, current state, gaps, and readiness

layers.desired_end_state: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS. Life optimization dashboard, habit tracking, goal setting, progress visualization, AI coaching UI. Responsive. Dark mode.
layers.current_state: Most mature of the three Trinity apps. Deployed isolated MVP at lyfeos.net. React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + shadcn/ui + Tailwind. Functional UI with multiple pages. GitHub and Beast aligned (no branch divergence).
layers.gap: Frontend is functional but may need enhancement per PRD v2.0. UMH-connected features not yet built. Production hardening needed (performance, accessibility, error boundaries).
layers.shared_standard_applicability: React/Vite/TypeScript/shadcn/Tailwind from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS has the strongest frontend. Isolated MVP is deployed and functional. Enhancement scope depends on PRD v1 vs v2 decision.

layers.desired_end_state: Express 4 + TypeScript API server. RESTful endpoints for habits, goals, progress, coaching, analytics. AI integration endpoints for NOVA AI coaching. Request validation.
layers.current_state: Express server deployed with lyfeos.net MVP. Basic CRUD endpoints functional. AI coaching endpoints may exist (NOVA AI referenced in PRD). Drizzle ORM.
layers.gap: API completeness relative to PRD unknown. UMH integration endpoints not built. Request validation not confirmed. NOVA AI integration scope unclear.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Express/TypeScript/Drizzle from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Backend is functional for current MVP. Expansion depends on PRD scope and UMH integration requirements.

layers.desired_end_state: Neon Postgres. Drizzle ORM schema. Separate LyfeOS database. 35+ tables covering habits, goals, progress, users, coaching sessions, analytics.
layers.current_state: 35 tables deployed. Drizzle schema exists. Database is functional for the isolated MVP. Most complete database of the three Trinity apps.
layers.gap: Database exists but may be on a development/staging Neon instance. Production database hardening needed. Backup verification needed. Schema may need expansion for PRD v2 features.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS has the most mature database. 35 tables is substantial. The question is whether the current database instance is production-grade or needs migration to a production Neon project.

layers.desired_end_state: Clerk authentication. Session management via Clerk. OAuth providers. User profile management via Clerk.
layers.current_state: Firebase or Passport.js legacy auth (unclear which is active on lyfeos.net). Auth works for the isolated MVP but uses legacy provider. Clerk target but lower urgency than CreatorOS.
layers.gap: Legacy auth provider must be migrated to Clerk. Migration is lower urgency than CreatorOS (no critical vulnerability) but still required for standardization.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Clerk auth from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS auth works (no bypass vulnerability like CreatorOS) but uses a legacy provider. Clerk migration is a standardization effort, not a security emergency. Lower priority than CreatorOS auth fix.

layers.desired_end_state: Fly.io deployment. Dockerized application. Production environment at lyfeos.net. Health check endpoint. Zero-downtime deploys.
layers.current_state: Deployed isolated MVP at lyfeos.net. Deployment mechanism unclear (may be Replit, Render, or another platform). Not on Fly.io. Not UMH-connected.
layers.gap: Need to migrate to Fly.io from current hosting. Current deployment is functional but not on the target platform. Deployment migration is lower risk because the app already works.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Fly.io deployment from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS is already deployed — the question is platform migration from current hosting to Fly.io. This is less risky than first-time deployment (EOS, CreatorOS).

layers.desired_end_state: Fly.io for application hosting. Neon for managed Postgres. Clerk for managed auth. CDN for static assets.
layers.current_state: Some cloud compute exists (current hosting provider). Neon Postgres may already be provisioned. Not on Fly.io.
layers.gap: Migration to Fly.io compute. May need Neon project migration if on a dev instance.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Fly.io + Neon + Clerk from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS has existing cloud compute that needs migration, not creation from scratch.

layers.desired_end_state: GitHub as version control. GitHub Actions CI/CD. Automated build, test, lint on PR. Automated deployment on main merge.
layers.current_state: GitHub repo exists. GitHub and Beast are aligned. No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions. No branch protection.
layers.gap: No CI/CD. No automated pipeline. Needs test suite first.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: GitHub + GitHub Actions from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS has the cleanest version control state — no branch divergence. CI/CD setup will be straightforward once tests exist.

layers.desired_end_state: RLS on user-scoped tables. Security headers. CSRF protection. HTTPS enforced. Secret management.
layers.current_state: No RLS. HTTPS likely on lyfeos.net (hosting provider). No security headers confirmed. No CSP. Drizzle parameterized queries.
layers.gap: No RLS on a 35-table database. Security headers not confirmed. No security audit performed.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: RLS + security headers from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS handles personal life data (habits, goals, coaching sessions). RLS is important for user privacy even though it is currently single-tenant/single-user.

layers.desired_end_state: Rate limiting on public endpoints. Strict limits on auth and AI coaching endpoints.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Rate limiting from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: AI coaching endpoints (NOVA AI) need strict rate limiting to control cost and prevent abuse.

layers.desired_end_state: CDN for static assets. API caching for analytics/progress queries. Browser caching headers.
layers.current_state: Unknown — depends on current hosting provider. May have basic CDN.
layers.gap: Caching strategy undefined. CDN configuration unclear.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: CDN + caching from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS progress/analytics data is read-heavy — caching could improve performance significantly.

layers.desired_end_state: Fly.io auto-scaling. Health check routing. Database connection pooling.
layers.gap: Fly.io migration needed. Scaling configuration to define.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Fly.io scaling from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: Low traffic initially. Single machine sufficient.

layers.desired_end_state: Structured logging. Error tracking. PostHog for product analytics. Error alerting.
layers.current_state: No confirmed error tracking or analytics on deployed MVP.
layers.gap: Observability gap. Production MVP running without error tracking.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: PostHog + error tracking from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS is the only deployed MVP — error tracking is more urgent here because users could be hitting errors now without anyone knowing.

layers.desired_end_state: Automated backups. Deployment rollback. Recovery runbook. Uptime monitoring.
layers.current_state: Deployed MVP — availability unknown. No confirmed backups. No rollback plan. No uptime monitoring.
layers.gap: Deployed app without recovery strategy. If the database is lost, user data is gone.
layers.shared_standard_applicability: Neon backups + rollback from OS Platform Standard v2
layers.app_specific_notes: LyfeOS is DEPLOYED with user data. Backup verification is more urgent here than for EOS/CreatorOS which have no deployment. If backups are not active, user data is at risk NOW.

summary.primary_blocker: Production hardening gaps (no error tracking, no confirmed backups, legacy auth). LyfeOS is the most mature but still has 13-layer gaps.
critical_risks: No confirmed backups on deployed MVP
summary.unique_concern: LyfeOS is the ONLY deployed Trinity app. It has real user data and no confirmed recovery strategy. Backup verification should be elevated to urgent.
